heading: Estimate your routine facilities enquiry workload
description: Estimate monthly time spent on routine tenant enquiries and the share of that current workload to review for a facilities service desk pilot.
intro: Estimate the time your team currently spends answering routine enquiries each month. Choose the share of enquiries to review for a pilot. Your inputs stay in this browser.
example: At 20 routine enquiries per operating day, 2 minutes per enquiry and 22 operating days, the monthly workload is about 14.7 hours. Reviewing 60% of those enquiries covers 264 enquiries and about 8.8 hours of that current workload.

fields.eligible: Share of routine enquiries to review (%)

result.review: Current workload in scope for review
result.requests: Monthly enquiries in scope for review
result.share: Share of routine enquiries under review

invalid: Enter a number within the range shown for each field.
methodHeading: Choose inputs for a pilot review
method: Record enquiry volumes and handling times during typical and busy periods. Use the observed figures to choose a representative daily count and average handling time.
Keep routine enquiries separate from unusual requests, urgent incidents and requests that need approval. Use the building’s existing channels for those cases.
Include staff time for checking answers, keeping approved guidance current and providing ongoing support when planning a pilot.
